headline.title: I put Google’s 24/7 AI assistant Gemini Spark to work, and it’s actually pretty useful
headline.summary: Google's AI assistant, Gemini Spark, is designed to automate various everyday tasks such as summarizing emails and planning local events. However, the rationale behind its release as a separate product remains unclear.

articles.title: As the browser wars heat up, here are the hottest alternatives to Chrome and Safari in 2026
articles.summary: The article provides an overview of various alternative web browsers that are emerging as competitors to Chrome and Safari in 2026. It highlights key features and advantages of these browsers, emphasizing their potential to reshape the current browser landscape.

articles.title: ‘What a joke’: Github Copilot’s new token-based billing spurs consternation among devs
articles.summary: GitHub Copilot has introduced a new token-based billing system, leading to dissatisfaction among developers who feel it undermines the tool's value. This change marks a significant shift in the pricing model for the AI-powered coding assistant.

articles.title: How one founder’s bet on ‘the old school web’ is paying off
articles.summary: Craig Campbell, a former Meta engineer, has opted to focus on developing a traditional website instead of pursuing opportunities in the AI sector, despite the influx of investment in that area. His decision is paying off as he leverages his experience to create a platform that stands apart from current AI trends.

articles.title: Meta is reportedly developing an AI pendant
articles.summary: Meta is reportedly working on an AI pendant, indicating a significant investment in AI-powered hardware. This development aligns with the company's broader strategy to integrate artificial intelligence into its product offerings.

articles.title: Do You Actually Need to Pay for Transcription Software?
articles.summary: The article evaluates the effectiveness of Wispr Flow and other AI-powered transcription software, comparing paid options to free services. It concludes whether investing in a subscription is worthwhile based on performance and features.

articles.title: AI grifters are creating fake Black people to sell Shein junk
articles.summary: The article discusses the emergence of AI-generated personas, specifically fake Black individuals, being used to promote and sell low-quality products from brands like Shein on platforms like TikTok. It highlights the struggles of real creators, such as a light-skinned Black woman, who face challenges in gaining visibility and support amidst this trend.

articles.title: Take our I/O 2026 quiz, vibe coded in Google AI Studio.
articles.summary: Google AI Studio has been utilized to create a quiz focused on the key announcements from I/O 2026. The interactive quiz aims to engage users with the latest developments showcased at the event.

articles.title: The SpaceX IPO is great for Elon Musk and terrible for you
articles.summary: Elon Musk has filed to take SpaceX public, drawing comparisons to the controversial WeWork IPO and raising concerns about potential risks for investors. Critics argue that the IPO could benefit Musk and his financiers at the expense of retail investors.

articles.title: 9 demos of Gemini Omni and Gemini 3.5 in action
articles.summary: The article showcases nine demonstrations of the Gemini Omni and Gemini 3.5, highlighting their capabilities and features. These demos illustrate the advancements in AI technology represented by the latest iterations of the Gemini series.

articles.title: Botnet of more than 17 million devices dismantled
articles.summary: A botnet consisting of over 17 million devices has been dismantled, which was linked to a Russia-based residential proxy network. The operation highlights ongoing efforts to combat large-scale cyber threats and improve internet security.

articles.title: Coders are refusing to work without AI — and that could come back to bite them
articles.summary: Researchers caution that while AI tools are enabling coders to work more efficiently, the quality of the code produced may not be improving, potentially leading to future issues. This reliance on AI could have negative consequences for developers if the quality of their output declines.
